verdict.rationale: Google Drive API covers most core UI actions programmatically: file CRUD, uploads (simple/multipart/resumable), sharing/permissions, metadata/properties, search/list, change notifications, and even bulk operations and template-based creation. However, no evidence confirms full parity for every UI feature (e.g., OCR search shown in community use, comments/version history UI, admin/security console features, or discoverable machine-readable API spec — llms.txt and openapi.json both 404), so API-vs-UI completeness isn't fully verified. Missing for 10: confirmation of full feature parity (comments, activity/version UI, OCR), a discoverable OpenAPI/llms.txt spec, and independent hands-on validation that all UI actions map to API calls.
